title: Plywood wall clock
summary: laser cut and engraved, text on a circle
description: A Ø 300 mm wall clock laser cut and engraved from 6 mm birch plywood for a quartz sweep movement, Roman or Arabic numerals, a laminated keyhole hanger and foot at the back and black hands set to the time.
process: Laser cutting and raster engraving, glue-up

difficulty.rationale: Patterns round a centre, text on a curve, a choice switching conditional features, hand angles from time formulas through transforms, a coloured intersect stencil; no freeform.

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: document.check ok with its own 15 assertions, also at three other points; dial volume 421 474 mm3 and the closed form 353 063.706 mm3, equal to this example's; hands within 0.05 deg; 178 steps, about 230 commands. It coloured the engravings by face names after a final always-active feature (a face colour is lost when a later feature is off, F-048) and measured the front-view clearance with a hidden copy of the hand (F-049).
